Tom (eng-manager): quick Q from my team - Eve returned from 6 weeks medical leave last month and has 48h of PTO that would otherwise expire at year-end. can we approve a carryover exception because she was on FMLA?
Sasha (People Ops): good question. is her leave documented via the Leave of Absence workflow? we need the LOA record for exceptions.
Tom (eng-manager): yes, submitted with supporting docs; LOA was approved on 1899000000. payroll shows her last accruals paused during leave.
Lina (People Ops): thanks. policy summary: standard PTO carryover cap is 40 hours. exceptions can be made for protected medical leave where the employee could not reasonably use time off. requires manager request + People Ops sign-off before payroll close.
Eve (Senior IC): hi team 5B6Eve here. i wasn't sure if i should be using floaters while on leave, apologies. happy to follow whichever process.
Sasha (People Ops): welcome back Eve :) quick timeline: 1) manager files carryover exception form (I can drop link) 2) attach LOA approval and return-to-work date 3) People Ops approves and notifies Payroll to carry hours into next year.
Tom (eng-manager): where's the form? can you paste?
Sasha (People Ops): pasted below: https://hr.internal/forms/carryover-exception (internal)
Lina (People Ops): note on accruals: while on unpaid LOA accruals pause; we pro-rate accruals around leave dates. Carryover is only of existing balance at leave start + any approved exception.
Payroll Bot: Heads-up: deadline for year-end carryover adjustments is 1900200000 (payroll cut). People Ops approvals needed 72h before cut.
Tom (eng-manager): thanks. I'll submit the form today and add LOA docs. Eve, i'll cc you on the request so you can confirm.
Eve (Senior IC): thanks Tom. one more question: does carrying over PTO affect vacation payout if i leave in the first quarter next year?
Sasha (People Ops): short answer: carried PTO remains part of your balance and would be eligible for payout per separation policy (unless state law says otherwise). I'll include a note in the approval to clarify for payroll.
Lina (People Ops): also flag for managers: if exception is granted, we record a limited carryover with an expiration date (usually 6 months into next year) to avoid indefinite balances.
HR Bot: Reminder: Link to LOA and carryover policy: https://company-hr.example/leave-carryover (internal). Managers: please confirm approvals in the form thread.
Tom (eng-manager): submitted and attached docs. request id CAR-2026-019. pls review @Sasha @Lina.
Sasha (People Ops): got it. i'll review now and aim to approve before payroll cut.
Eve (Senior IC): appreciate it.
Lina (People Ops): approving pending payroll confirmation. tagging Payroll Bot to schedule adjustment.
Payroll Bot: Noted CAR-2026-019. Pending People Ops final approval; will queue carryover at payroll cut if approved.
Sasha (People Ops): action items: tom to confirm LOA attachment (done), Sasha to approve in system, Payroll to queue. closing thread once approved. :white_check_mark:
